- **Date:** 2026-05-12  
  **Source:** [OpenAI — Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API](https://openai.com/index/advancing-voice-intelligence-with-new-models-in-the-api/)  
  **Summary:** OpenAI announced GPT-Realtime-2, GPT-Realtime-Translate, and GPT-Realtime-Whisper for voice reasoning, live speech translation, and streaming transcription.  
  **Why it matters:** OpenAI is pushing voice from transcription/response into real-time, multilingual, reasoning-capable interaction.

- **Date:** 2026-05-12  
  **Source:** [Google DeepMind — AI Pointer](https://deepmind.google/blog/ai-pointer/)  
  **Summary:** Google DeepMind introduced a Gemini-powered AI pointer interaction model: users point and speak instead of writing detailed prompts. Initial implementations are planned for Gemini in Chrome and AI Studio demos.  
  **Why it matters:** This is a UI-layer move toward multimodal agent control, reducing prompt burden and making browser/workspace agents more direct.

- **Date:** 2026-05-12  
  **Source:** [TechCrunch — Google brings agentic AI and vibe-coded widgets to Android](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/12/google-brings-agentic-ai-and-vibe-coded-widgets-to-android/)  
  **Summary:** Google announced Gemini Intelligence features for Android, including cross-app task execution, Gboard AI dictation, form filling, browsing, and natural-language widget creation.  
  **Why it matters:** Google is moving Gemini agent capabilities closer to the mobile OS layer, where distribution and default workflows matter.

- **Date:** 2026-05-12  
  **Source:** [TechCrunch — Anthropic expands Claude for Legal](https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/12/the-ai-legal-services-industry-is-heating-up-anthropic-is-getting-in-on-the-action/)

## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

- **Date:** 2026-05-12  
  **Source:** [YouTube — The Best Way to Talk to Your Agents](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NNxGQw1uQHc)  
  **Summary:** The actionable tactic is to use richer structured handoffs, especially HTML, when coordinating with AI agents: stage context, files, next actions, references, and status in a navigable artifact rather than relying only on flat Markdown.  
  **How to use it:** Create an `agent-handoff.html` with sections for objective, current state, constraints, file links, task checklist, decision log, and next command. Keep it local or attach it to the agent session. Update it as the working state changes.  
  **Available now:** Yes. Works with any coding or research agent that can read local files or rendered HTML.  
  **Why it matters:** Structured handoffs reduce ambiguity in multi-step agent work and make long-running tasks easier to resume or delegate.
